layers.name: NC OneMap Parcels (PRIMARY ArcGIS REST geometry)
layers.notes: PRIMARY public ArcGIS REST for Columbus. Filter cntyfips='047'. Verified 2026-09-24: count 51709; ownname/siteadd/altparno ~51091; landval>0 51080; improvval>0 24914; parval>0 only 18709 (incomplete — prefer taxdata GTOTVL); Shape__Area 5–150 ac (217800–6534000 sqft) → 12081. CRITICAL: gisacres field is broken for Columbus (orders of magnitude too small) — derive acreage as Shape__Area/43560 (CRS 102719/2264 feet). Join key parno = taxdata GPIN; altparno = taxdata GSEQ (zero-pad 6 for PRC deep-link). No sale price on OneMap. MaxRecordCount 5000. Geo sample parno 0263.00-95-7227.000 centroid ~-78.767, 34.397 (Columbus).

layers.name: Columbus County taxdata CAMA export (PRIMARY attributes)
layers.notes: Daily-ish TABLE-format export (extension .xls but magic TABLE not OLE). Verified 2026-09-24: 53516 rows / 47 columns. GACRE 5–150 → 12238; GACRE>0 39589; GSLAMT>0 19025; GTOTVL>0 53478; TVLAND>0 51495; GPURL on every row. Join to OneMap on GPIN=parno (or GSEQ=altparno). Prefer GACRE over OneMap Shape__Area for site-search acres; prefer GTOTVL over OneMap parval. GCICOD router: blank=unincorp 40172, WH Whiteville 4047, SW Tabor City 2691, WA Lake Waccamaw 2026, CH Chadbourn 1660, FB Fair Bluff 973, BO Bolton 622, SF Sandyfield 517, BR Brunswick 352, BD Boardman 243, CG Cerro Gordo 213. GPURL pattern https://www2.columbusco.org/prc/pid{GSEQ:06d}.pdf verified 200 PDF.

layers.name: MangoMap Land Records — Parcels (viewer + identify)
layers.notes: Jurisdiction GIS viewer (not ArcGIS FeatureServer). MangoMap hosted polygons count 57075 (2026-09-24). Popup fields match taxdata CAMA. Per-feature GeoJSON: GET /maps/{mapId}/get_feature_geo_json?shape_table_name=shp_b8123278_d6a7_11e7_98bc_06765ea3034e&gid={gid}. No bulk ArcGIS REST — use OneMap+taxdata for wire ingest. Also annual Sales 2019–2024 polygon overlays (Sales 2024 count 2527).

layers.name: MangoMap Zoning (cities-first jurisdicti)
layers.notes: PRIMARY zoning — cities-first. SLD classifies by jurisdicti: Whiteville, Tabor City, Chadbourn, Lake Waccamaw, Fair Bluff, Bolton, SandyField, Brunswick, Boardman, Cerro Gordo, Columbus County, General Use. Verified count 1619 polygons (2026-09-24). No county ArcGIS FeatureServer for zoning; Whiteville/towns do not publish separate zoning FS. Spatial-join onto OneMap parcels; inside city limits prefer matching jurisdicti over Columbus County/General Use. Land Use Regulation Ordinance PDF: https://www.columbusco.org/sites/default/files/uploads/planning/land-use-regulation-ordinance.pdf

layers.name: MangoMap City and Town Limits
layers.notes: Verified count 28 polygons (includes districts + limits). Use with GCICOD / zoning jurisdicti for city-first router. Also on Land Records map as City Limits layer 5a774e4c-8b2f-11e6-9a78-06c182e4d011 (same shape_table).

layers.name: Comprehensive Land Use Plan (CLUP) — PDF only
layers.notes: No public FLU FeatureServer / MapServer found 2026-09-24. CLUP + HWA addendum PDFs only. FLU gap for wire ingest.

layers.name: MangoMap annual Sales overlays (2019–2024)

tax.note: OneMap parval only partial (landval near-complete). Authoritative values in county taxdata export (DIF format despite .xls): GTOTVL>0 53482 / TVLAND; join GPIN↔OneMap parno.

sale.note: Not on REST except OneMap saledate (populated but unreliable as sale). Use taxdata export GSLAMT (price) / GSLDTE (date MM/DD/YYYY): GSLAMT>0 19027, GSLDTE non-blank 53520. Deed image GDURL.

ownerEntity.rule: Concatenate owner fields, uppercase and trim, then flag as entity if the convention regex matches (batch convention; TRUSTEE does not match TRUST; LIFE ESTATE / ESTATE are not flagged). regexExtended is an optional wider net (CO, TR/TRS/TRUSTEE, MINISTRIES, ASSOCIATION, BANK, SCHOOL, DEPT/DEPARTMENT, BOARD, any 'X OF' government form, leading NORTH CAROLINA/NC).
ownerEntity.countNote: Counts computed 2026-09-28 by pulling owner fields for every parcel in the 5–150 ac filter (objectId paging) and applying the Python regex client-side.

paDeepLink.note: Returns application/pdf property/appraisal card; parcel verified in PDF text. {GSEQ6} = taxdata GSEQ (≈ OneMap altparno) zero-padded to 6.

gaps: Parcel REST is NC OneMap only (gisacres broken → Shape__Area/43560); sale price and full values from taxdata DIF export, not REST
